segments.english:
11043—Habiba bint Mulayl [5]
—with two lams, in the diminutive form—ibn Wabara ibn Khalid ibn al-Ajlan, an Ansari woman of the Banu Awf ibn al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj.

[1] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6839.
[2] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6840.
[3] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6841.
[4] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6842.
[5] Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6843.

segments.arabic: بايعت النبيّ ﷺ، وتزوجها فروة بن عمرو بن ورقة بن عبيد بن عامر بن بياضة، فولدت له عبد الرحمن بن فروة. أسنده ابن مندة عن ابن سعد أيضا.
segments.english: She pledged allegiance to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). Farwa ibn Amr ibn Waraqa ibn Ubayd ibn Amir ibn Bayada married her, and she bore him Abd al-Rahman ibn Farwa. Ibn Manda also transmitted this with an isnad from Ibn Sa'd.
